title: Adopter infrastructure context (/onboard)
description: Schema for <service_slug>_context.local.yaml, generated by the template-onboard skill / /onboard workflow (ADR-029 Wave 3). Distinct from context.schema.json (ADR-023 company/project risk context, consumed by risk_context.py) — this file captures adopter-specific infrastructure wiring (cloud provider, registry, tracking URIs), never secrets (D-17/D-18).

container_registry.description: e.g. gcr.io/my-org/ or 123456.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/. null when profile is local.

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: file://./mlruns for local; a tracking server URL for staging/prod.

dvc_remote.description: e.g. gs://my-bucket/dvc/ or s3://my-bucket/dvc/. null when profile is local.

monitoring_endpoint.description: Prometheus push gateway URL. null when profile is local.
